# Ollama snapshot upgrade fixtures

Generated by unmodified `lib/store.js` and its dependencies at
`b867bfae77ce2de8efceaa25485c70c0f3e5dfba` (dsh-cost-meter 1.9.16).
All sessions and accounts are synthetic; no user ledger was read.

The generator constructs `new Ledger(sanitizeConfig({ currency: 'USD',
exchangeRate: 7, priceOverrides }), {}, path)` at `2026-10-19T00:00:00Z`,
calls `ledger.account({ input: row.input }, row.model, sessionId,
Date.parse(row.at), row.provider)` for each entry in `sessions.json`, then closes
the ledger. USD configuration keeps the default CNY exchange rate of 7.2.

- `automatic.json` uses empty overrides. Both tagged Ollama models are unpriced.
- `aliased.json` maps each tagged model explicitly to its DeepSeek base model.
  The old resolver charges DeepSeek's calendar, so Flash costs 0.30 at 07:00 UTC
  and 0.15 at 13:00 UTC. Pro costs 1.32 at 07:00 UTC.

The upgrade regression loads these exact files, preserves their historical
matching policy and amounts across replay/detail/projection/restart, prices new
calls with the corrected calendar, then explicitly reprices one model while
retaining the original exchange rate and untouched models.
